title: Intermediates and phases
hints: Look at the physical state symbols.
Cancellation requires the same species in the same state.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: The substances differ in phase and enthalpy. A phase-change step can connect them if the target requires it.
statement:
A Hess sum contains $\ce{H2O(l)}$ on one side and $\ce{H2O(g)}$ on the other. What should you do?

[_]{a}

choices: Keep them distinct; add a phase-change step if needed.
explanations: The physical state is part of a thermochemical equation.
The enthalpy of vaporization would be lost.
